text:
irene: MeterPro (acct 5561) opened a ticket 126 - says April invoice shows 48 hours of reserved capacity twice in two different PDFs. One PDF total is $9,600, the other $19,200. They were actually charged $19,200. attaching screenshots.
matt: yikes. which invoice ids?
irene: INV-2026-0419 and INV-2026-0419-R1. R1 has doubled hours.
olga: @billing-gateway-bot pull run 2026-04-19-5561 and meter imports from MeterPro for that billing window. Also fetch dispatched PDFs.
billing-gateway-bot: run id=2026-04-19-5561 started 2026-04-19T02:00Z finished with warnings. Warnings: [meter_import:overlap_detected], [pdf_dispatch:duplicate_send]. PDFs: INV-2026-0419_v1.pdf (total $9,600), INV-2026-0419_v2.pdf (total $19,200).
meterpro-ops: we pushed a daylight-saving-adjusted feed on 2026-04-19 that caused an overlap for the 02:00-04:00 window for several customers. some rows duplicated. sorry, that's on us.
matt: ok, duplicate rows came from vendor feed. why did our invoice service produce two different published PDFs?
olga: looks like first invoice published before we received late-arriving meter rows. later import triggered a regen that appended duplicated hours, and the PDF dispatcher retried causing both versions to be emailed. publish logic then overwrote the portal with the later regen.
irene: customer says their card shows the higher charge ($19,200) and portal shows the lower invoice ($9,600). very confusing for their accounting. they want a corrected portal invoice matching their charge or a refund.
meterpro-ops: we can provide a signed feed correction and retract the duplicate rows. we'll also reprocess the feed to remove overlap and send a corrected usage file.
matt: immediate plan: 1) place acct 5561 in billing-hold; 2) determine which PDF was attached to payment capture; 3) regen canonical invoice after vendor correction; 4) if payment equals higher amount, publish correction that matches capture and void the lower portal invoice, plus get vendor to issue invoice-level correction for the duplicate meter rows.
billing-gateway-bot: payment trace: capture id=pay_x12a amount_cents=1920000 attached to INV-2026-0419_v2.pdf. DB invoice shows v1 (9,600) due to later overwrite.
olga: so payment matches the doubled invoice. we must not overwrite a paid invoice with an unpaid lower-totals render. regen should produce canonical invoice consistent with capture. Also ask MeterPro to issue a signed correction and indemnification for any disputes.
meterpro-ops: we'll retract duplicated rows and republish sanitized file within 2 hours. we'll include correction manifest and contact info for reconciliation.
irene: finance: can you prepare a provisional credit memo in case we need to refund? also prepare the correction email template referencing vendor feed correction.
finance-bot: created provisional credit CM-2026-1150 for acct 5561 amount_cents=1920000 status: pending-approval. Approver: matt.
matt: approved as placeholder. but mark it contingent on final regen. add analyst note: "duplicate meter rows from vendor feed caused double-billing in regen; awaiting vendor correction."
olga: after vendor reprocess, I'll run a dry-run regen with publish=false and post CSV. If the sanitized totals match the charged amount, we'll publish INV-2026-0419-CAPTURE that aligns portal to charge and request MeterPro indemnity. If sanitized total is lower, we'll coordinate refund and vendor reimbursement.
billing-gateway-bot: dry-run after vendor correction completed: canonical invoice total cents=960000 (i.e., $9,600). Lines show duplicate rows removed.
matt: that means the payment captured $19,200 but canonical invoice should be $9,600. Two options: refund the overcharge and ask vendor to reimburse OR keep charge and issue credit with documented vendor indemnity. What's legal stance?
finance-bot: flagged legal for vendor reimbursement path. created case with legal id LEG-2026-77.
meterpro-ops: we can commit to reimbursing the overcharge and will provide payment instruction within 5 business days. will also update feed to prevent repeats (adding overlap-detection window).
matt: short-term for customer: issue refund of $9,600 to match canonical invoice and void the higher invoice in portal, then re-bill correctly. Also keep a record of the captured charge and reversal. Finance, please process refund and apply CM-2026-1150.
finance-bot: refund scheduled for 9,600.00 USD and CM-2026-1150 applied. Portal updated: INV-2026-0419_v2 voided, INV-2026-0419-CORR issued with corrected totals.
irene: send signed correction email to customer including MeterPro correction manifest and note: "A vendor metering overlap led to duplicate usage rows; we've voided the incorrect invoice, issued a corrected invoice, and processed a refund. MeterPro will reimburse the overbilled amount."
meterpro-ops: sending manifest and formal reimbursement schedule to finance and legal. Also committing to new overlap checks and an SLA credit.
matt: root cause: vendor feed daylight-saving overlap + late-arriving rows + our regen overwrote paid invoice. Mitigations: 1) reject late-arriving meter rows after publish cutover unless vendor supplies correction manifest; 2) make invoice publish immutable after payment capture; 3) add vendor overlap-detection and a pre-import validation step.
irene: customer confirmed refund and receipt of corrected invoice. closing thread. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
